attackers_goals: Attackers can attempt to extract and decrypt the ADFS certificate that is used to sign SAML tokens, and fabricate a new SAML token.
description: The Windows Internal Database (WID) was queried in an unusual way on an ADFS server.
investigative_actions: See whether this was a legitimate action. Follow the causality chain/user/host activities. Monitor suspicious LDAP queries to the ADFS container in Active Directory. Check the possibility of a compromised ADFS server. Check for unusual Azure AD authentications. Check for unusual logins.
name: Unusual access to the Windows Internal Database on an ADFS server
required_data: XDR Agent with eXtended Threat Hunting (XTH)
